topics.title: FCC grants SpaceX conditional approval for 1 million orbital AI data center satellites
topics.summary: On November 25, 2026, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission granted SpaceX conditional authority to deploy up to 1 million non-geostationary satellites for its SpaceX Orbital Data Center System (Starmind). The order overcame petitions from Amazon, Viasat and the American Astronomical Society over orbital debris, interference and astronomy impacts.

topics.title: PrismML releases Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B for local agentic coding
topics.summary: On November 24, 2026, PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, an open-weight model based on Qwen 3.8 27B compressed to 5.9 GB using ternary weights. PrismML reports an average score of 54.2 across SWE-bench Verified, DeepSWE v1.1 and Terminal-Bench 2.1, up from 37.9 for Bonsai 2, and 82.2 on AppWorld and Tau3-Bench.

topics.title: STOXX and ACU Markets partner to develop AI compute price benchmarks
topics.summary: STOXX Ltd. and ACU Markets announced on November 25, 2026, a collaboration to explore independent AI compute benchmarks and market infrastructure. The effort pairs ACU Markets' compute reference-rate methodology with STOXX's index governance and distribution to support procurement, risk management and potential financial products.
